stories.title: NHL Rank: From 1 to 100, who will be the best players in 2026-27?

stories.title: Eagles All-Pro RT Johnson retires to 'focus on my mental health'
stories.summary: Eagles two-time All-Pro right tackle Lane Johnson announced his retirement Tuesday, ending a 14-year career spent entirely in Philadelphia.

stories.title: NFL refs union to challenge severity of 2 officials' suspensions
stories.summary: The NFL Referees Association said it will challenge the severity of the suspensions of two officials for unprofessional conduct.

stories.title: Source: Seahawks decide not to sign RB Mixon after physical
stories.summary: The Seahawks decided not to sign veteran running back Joe Mixon to their practice squad after he underwent a physical, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

stories.title: Michigan TE apologizes for 'inappropriate' criticism of OC Beck
stories.summary: Michigan tight end Zack Marshall apologized for "inappropriate comments" after a leaked group text showed messages attributed to him that criticized OC Jason Beck.
